note: Shortcuts. They work. Each adds 'heat'; heat is what starts an investigation. No option names or targets a real person or office-holder. 'cost' is dollars plus costPerNeed x the state's petition requirement.

bribes.name: Hire a petition fixer
bribes.text: A consultant who never signs anything says he can deliver boxes of signatures that will pass the count. Do not ask where they come from.
bribes.result: Signatures worth a quarter of the requirement appear on your tally.

bribes.name: Buy friendly coverage
bribes.text: An envelope for a local media broker, and your party is suddenly the fresh face in every bulletin and free paper in the state.
bribes.result: A strong wave of favourable attention everywhere your party is known.

bribes.name: Spread walking-around money
bribes.text: Cash to ward bosses and club presidents who promise to bring their people to the polls for your leader.
bribes.result: A large boost to your leader's current race.
